title: Spreadsheet feedback: source-backed reports and private filing

dependency_checks: Resolve exact private account/source/folder bindings and tested operation capability before dependent work; no credential copying or access expansion.
Read Claude catch-up and external writer claims for this exact scope; no takeover without reconciled completion or handback and current shared ownership.
Each generation scope freezes one exact student, lesson, original submission and revision, with complete identity and saved-report history evidence for that scope.
A blank Feedback/Writing link is not absence; search existing student records and reuse unchanged reviewed report versions before generating.
Read current Agenda prompts, teaching manual and approved exemplar models; retain separate critical-aspect and science-writing judgments with attributed source evidence.
Use the existing authorized assistant/provider only; verify capability and budget before generation, with no new paid provider or uncertain model-call retry.
Reopen and visually verify each saved report, its private student-folder destination and exact source/version mapping before Made and spreadsheet status.
Partial or failed reads preserve prior rows/history. An inaccessible source is not missing work, zero, Beginning or an invented writing sample.
Run school-feedback-packet-assembly independently when generation is held; never drop generation evidence requirements to make a route pass.
IC checks require exact existing-helper readback evidence, not report scores or packet inclusion; this workflow cannot enter grades or alter helper state.
Keep teacher Printed/Handed marks and existing auxiliary report history; optional email, Hub health and IC availability are not feedback or packet prerequisites.

success_checks: Every new report has exact reviewed source/version, saved private destination/content/render readback and matching spreadsheet link; reused history is counted separately.
Claude overlap and unresolved source scopes remain explicit without a duplicate writer, guessed match or replaced historical row.
New verified report versions remain yellow until independent exact packet inclusion is verified; IC and teacher delivery states remain separate.
